decks.notes: This deck focuses on using aggressive Elemental creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy revolves around generating card advantage with Keruga, the Macrosage as the companion, allowing you to draw extra cards. The deck also includes versatile instant spells like Dead / Gone and Fire / Ice to control the opponent's board and protect your creatures. Leyline Binding helps to lock down the opponent's key threats. Teferi, Time Raveler disrupts the opponent's strategy and provides additional card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and efficient spell choices.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to exchange Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending provide removal options, while Spell Pierce and Prismari Command offer counterplay and flexibility. The triomes and fetchlands ensure consistent mana fixing, while Xander's Lounge provides a card draw engine. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with unexpected and game-changing creature exchanges while maintaining control.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to take advantage of the token-generating abilities of Wrenn and Six and Archon of Cruelty to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for extra copies of key combo pieces, while cards like Prismari Command, Spell Pierce, and Lightning Bolt provide disruption and protection. The mana base is designed to support the deck's various color requirements, with access to powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for added versatility. The deck relies on a mix of creativity and efficient plays to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing equipment, specifically Colossus Hammer, to quickly equip to creatures like Ornithopter and create a powerful threat. The key is to set up a board state where you can quickly attach hammers to your creatures, often with the help of Puresteel Paladin or Stoneforge Mystic. Protecting your creatures with cards like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes is essential to maintain your combo. Using Urza's Saga to find essential pieces like Sigarda's Aid and Nettlecyst will help you overwhelm your opponents quickly and efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells while abusing the Cascade mechanic to generate additional value and tempo advantage. By casting spells like Violent Outburst and Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to quickly flood the board with creatures and put pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan and control the opponent's spells. Ultimately, the goal is to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow for creative combos and interactions to control the game and disrupt the opponent. It combines powerful creatures, spells, and enchantments to establish board presence and generate advantage. The key strategy is to use cards like Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to manipulate the battlefield and dictate the flow of the game, while also utilizing efficient removal and countermagic to disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck aims to outmaneuver and outsmart the opponent through a mix of creativity and strategic plays.

The deck uses cycling creatures and cards like Violent Outburst to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The mana base is fine-tuned to ensure the right colors are available for casting spells efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to control the game early on and then overwhelm the opponent with a huge board presence from the graveyard.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck focuses on early aggression with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death allows for additional value and flexibility in combat. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure and control the game from the early turns.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent by utilizing efficient creatures and spells. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Mana Tithe and Blood Moon. It capitalizes on powerful creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Solitude, and Seasoned Pyromancer to deal damage and generate card advantage. The deck's plan is further bolstered by the inclusion of powerful companions, with Obosh, the Preypiercer providing additional damage output.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities that can help to generate value and control the board while also enabling a combo finish with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The deck utilizes creature tutor spells like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to find the necessary pieces for the combo, while also utilizing mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots to ramp and fix mana. The overall strategy revolves around maximizing the synergies between the creatures in the deck to overwhelm the opponent and secure a win.

This deck aims to use powerful cards like Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to quickly bring out high-impact threats such as Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The key is to use spells like Lightning Bolt, Spell Pierce, and Prismari Command to control the board and protect your combo pieces, while also utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler for additional value. The land base includes fetch lands and a variety of fetchable dual lands to ensure consistent mana fixing. Expressive Iteration is used for card advantage and selection.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity as the key card to generate powerful combos and create game-winning board states. It utilizes a mix of creatures and spells that provide value when sacrificed or enter the battlefield, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes several removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismari Command to control the board and protect the combo. Leyline Binding is used to prevent opponents from casting noncreature spells. Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption and card advantage, while Wrenn and Six allows for consistent land drops. The deck includes a variety of lands to ensure proper mana fixing and consistency.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also incorporates a control aspect with cards like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to be versatile and unpredictable, combining elements of combo and control to outsmart opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful Elemental creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells in order to control the board and take advantage of the opponent's hand. This deck revolves around leveraging the graveyard with Underworld Breach to combo off and win the game quickly. By using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate value and card advantage, as well as utilizing artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber to fuel the combo, the deck aims to assemble a lethal combination of cards to secure victory. With the ability to disrupt opponents with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and grind out wins with Grinding Station, this deck is versatile and powerful in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.
